item.title: Nvidia 要買 Hugging Face？
item.summary: 看到消息，現在是看起來在談的階段就有消息出來了 (連數字都冒出來)，NVIDIA 想買 Hugging Face：「Nvidia has been in talks to acquire Hugging Face for more than $13 billion (via)」。 然後報導提到微軟的興趣，不過沒有繼續跑： Microsoft also met with Hugging Face, but the person familiar and a second person said talks are not ongoing. 這個併購案至少從基礎建設的角度來看是合理的 (看得懂的)...
